mechanism: Infliximab (TNF-alpha inhibitor) increases tuberculosis reactivation risk, and pyrazinamide is a first-line TB drug often used in patients with TB; concurrent use requires careful TB screening and monitoring as infliximab significantly increases TB susceptibility.
action: Ensure tuberculosis screening (TST, IGRA, chest X-ray) before initiating infliximab; if pyrazinamide is needed for TB treatment, continue infliximab only if TB is being adequately treated and consider risk-benefit analysis with infectious disease consultation.
